sections.title: Life cycle and habitat
sections.text: Eschscholzia californica, the California poppy, is an annual or perennial 5–60 cm tall, native to western North America. It grows in dry grassland, open ground and sunny slopes.

sections.title: Flowers and fruit
sections.text: Its yellow to orange flowers are 2–6 cm across and rise above finely divided foliage. The upright, slender capsules are about 3–9 cm long.

sections.title: Caution
sections.text: Botanical sources report potential toxicity; information about commercial products does not establish the safety of every plant part. Do not eat it based on its common name alone.
